question: By what is the pervaded-pervader relation established?
premises: the pervaded-pervader relation of tattvas is shown
it is established by greater quality
it is not established by causality or simplicity
inference: The pervaded-pervader relation is established by greater quality, not by causality or simplicity.
plain_english: The pervaded-pervader relation shown of the tattvas is established by greater quality, not by causality nor by simplicity.
